By CYBER ATTACK SI 101 (2020). Champion 2-Year-Old Colt, 7 wins, $1,721,346, Los Alamitos
Two Million Fut. [G1], Ruidoso Derby [G1], 2nd Golden State Million Fut. [G1], Rainbow Fut.
[G1], Rainbow Derby [G1]. Brother to ENFORCE SI 102 (Champion). His first foals are
yearlings of 2026. Son of stakes winner FAVORITE CARTEL SI 104; sire of 158 stakes winners,
8 champions, including TRANE STATION V SI 97 (Champion, $1,754,152 [G1]), CARTEL JESS
ROCKIN SI 96 (Champion, $849,101 [G1]), TELL CARTEL SI 105 (Champion, $796,386 [G1]).
